hypotheses.reasoning: The same message, msg-147644 at offset 885603, makes the consumer crash every time it is processed: a stack overflow in expandReferences, which points to a self-referencing or very deeply nested payload. The consumer was processing batches normally just before (#118). After each crash it restarts and hits the same offset again, which is the CrashLoopBackOff, and lag rises behind it. Other services show no errors.
A recursion bug in expandReferences is possible, but I found no deploy in the logs and the consumer was healthy until it reached this one message.

verdict.recommendedAction: Move msg-147644 (offset 885603) to a dead-letter queue or skip past it, then restart order-consumer. Add a recursion depth limit or cycle detection to expandReferences, and send messages that fail repeatedly to a DLQ.
